event.bram_heart5.0.text: Wait. I don't say things often. Today I'm saying one.
event.bram_heart5.0.why: drops the Hm opener so the tic stays a signature

dlg.story.whistler.bram.0.text: I whistle. Don't tell Wren. She'd count the notes as words.
dlg.story.whistler.bram.0.why: no back-to-back Hm after the intro

dlg.story.whistler.bram.r0.text: Hm. Hello. Yes. We'll blame the wind. It owes me.
dlg.story.whistler.bram.r0.why: no kettle in the village square; teasing aimed at weather

event.story_whistler_bram.after.text: My teacher whistled that tune. Same wrong note. I kept it.
event.story_whistler_bram.after.why: works in all three branches, not only the wrong-note one

event.bram_heart4.after.text: It'll hold. Juno would've used half the strikes. Don't tell her.
event.bram_heart4.after.why: every reply before it already opens with Hm

dlg.bram.long.0.text: I worked alone for years, told myself I liked it, lied, and then you kept sitting down. I wrote my teacher thirty letters. Sent none.
dlg.bram.long.0.why: one 17-word sentence: the longest he has ever said

event.bram_heart6.after.text: That's all of it. The letters stay in the drawer. For now.
event.bram_heart6.after.why: less Hm wallpaper; the drawer thread stays

event.bram_heart8.after.text: I'll tell her. Today. Or near today.
event.bram_heart8.after.why: the replies carry the Hm; promise pays off in Next Door

event.bram_heart10.intro.text: Hm. Stand still. Don't speak. It's easier.
event.bram_heart10.intro.why: Juno's heart 10 opens on 'Hold out your hand' in the same forge

event.bram_heart10.thanks.text: {if choice:bram.juno.ask}You asked what I see. I see a friend, [player]. Rare metal.{else}...Hm. Saved it nine winters. Didn't know who for. Now I do. [player].{/if}
event.bram_heart10.thanks.why: first time he says the name, in both branches

event.bram_friend.intro.text: Hm. Wednesday. Marcus comes for lunch. Late today. Take his half.
event.bram_friend.intro.why: Marcus's own lines meet Bram at the bench on Wednesdays; no longer says his half is free

event.bram_friend.wrap.text: Good lunch. Marcus will find crumbs on his half. He'll count them. Twice.
event.bram_friend.wrap.why: calls back Marcus's count-twice habit; replaces a third 'Don't tell'

dlg.bram.birthday.r2.text: Hm. Left side. It's warmer. I checked.

event.bram_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.bram.wish}Here. One bar. A good year needs something to start on.{else}{if choice:bday.bram.gift}Your turn. Iron. One bar. Fair trade.{else}Best birthday in years. Here. Iron. Don't make it a thing.{/if}{/if}
event.bram_birthday.after.why: the reply before each branch has the Hm; wish branch no longer repeats r0's joke

threads.bram_heart2: Who was the teacher who could see the right color from the door?
threads.bram_heart5: He should tell his teacher something. Will he?
threads.bram_heart4: Bram rates Juno's work above his own, and will not say so to her.
threads.bram_heart6: Thirty letters in a drawer, 'for now'.
threads.bram_heart8: He promised to tell Juno today, or near today.
threads.bram_heart10: He finally said the player's name; what else has he been saving?
threads.story_whistler_bram: A tune with a wrong note, handed down from his teacher.
threads.bram_friend: Marcus is late to the Wednesday bench; the player wants to see the two of them at lunch.
threads.bram_birthday: Juno's card came. No other mail: the teacher's word still has not arrived.
threads.overheard_bram_marcus_2: Marcus measured Bram's grip without him noticing.
threads.overheard_bram_marcus_3: Whose nails were straighter? Wednesday decides.
threads.overheard_tilda_bram_1: What else has Bram fixed for Tilda without being asked?

notes: story_notes_juno: ACCEPT. Six of Juno's notes in his apron pocket, believed to be Tilda's, fits his secret pride and the never-say-thank-you slate with Tilda. No Bram line contradicts it; keep 'six'.
hall_dance: Bram's .7 has no number and no dancing; kept. Wren's six-winters fix and the separate-dances narration already read right in the assembled card.
bram_friend vs Marcus: overheard_bram_marcus_1/3 have Marcus meet Bram on Wednesdays at the bench; Bram's friend intro said Marcus's half was free that day. Fixed on Bram's side (Marcus is late).
bram_heart10.thanks now uses [player] in both branches under the granted exemption; dlg.bram.long.0 runs one 17-word sentence under the 18-word allowance.
bram_heart10 / juno_heart10: both opened on 'Hold out your hand(s)' in the same forge; Bram's intro changed.
next_door / overheard_juno_bram_4: both use 'the good tongs' and can play in either order; reads as promise and payoff either way. No change.
overheard_juno_bram_2.l4 mentions a clasp that is not in the scene (the shipped line); left as is, but Juno's l1/l3 could name the clasp if the Director wants it tighter.
